post_call_analysis_data.name: call_category
post_call_analysis_data.description: Classify caller purpose based on the actual conversation. Customer brand alone does not imply warranty.

post_call_analysis_data.name: customer_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract customer name only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract caller name only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: company
post_call_analysis_data.description: The company represented by a business caller, only when explicitly stated. Empty for ordinary repair customers, including warranty customers. Never use the appliance brand or the called repair business as company.

post_call_analysis_data.name: phone
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract phone only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_phone
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract callback phone only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_address
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract service address only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appliance_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract appliance type only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: brand
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract brand only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: issue
post_call_analysis_data.description: Describe the appliance symptom in clear words using the whole conversation. Resolve obvious transcription ambiguity from context (for example, will not drain). Do not diagnose or invent symptoms.

post_call_analysis_data.name: job_description
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract job description only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: Extract notes only when explicitly provided. Empty string if missing. Never invent details, coverage, dates, or outcomes.
